name: popcomputer-web-demo
description: A starting point for @popcomputer/web on Cloudflare Workers: React pages, D1 and Better Auth.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && echo 'Types: no errors' && oxlint && echo 'Lint: no problems' && bun test
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:setup: bun run cloudflare:database && bun run cloudflare:secret
scripts.cloudflare:secret: bun scripts/app-name.ts && openssl rand -base64 32 | wrangler secret put BETTER_AUTH_SECRET -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: bun scripts/app-name.ts && bun run build && bun run db:migrate && wrangler deploy
